Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Ben Wallace?

Ben Wallace is 51 years old.

Where was Ben Wallace born?

Ben Wallace was born in White Hall, Alabama.

When was Ben Wallace born?

Ben Wallace was born on September 10, 1974.

How tall is Ben Wallace?

Ben Wallace is 6-9 (206 cm) tall.

How much did Ben Wallace weigh when playing?

Ben Wallace weighed 240 lbs (108 kg) when playing.

Is Ben Wallace in the Hall of Fame?

Ben Wallace was inducted to the Hall of Fame as a Player in 2021 (Full List) .

What position did Ben Wallace play?

Center and Power Forward.

When did Ben Wallace retire?

Ben Wallace last played in 2012.

What is Ben Wallace's net worth?

Ben Wallace made at least $97,800,795 playing professional basketball.

Ben Wallace made $16,000,000 in 2007.

What did Ben Wallace average?

Ben Wallace averaged 5.7 points, 9.6 rebounds, and 1.3 assists per game.

How many rings does Ben Wallace have?

Ben Wallace won one championship.

What schools did Ben Wallace attend?

Ben Wallace attended Central in Hayneville, Alabama, Cuyahoga Community College and Virginia Union University.

What are Ben Wallace's nicknames?

Big Ben, Body, Debo are nicknames for Ben Wallace.
